data.one_liner: iOS-style full-screen back swipe gesture PageRoute that avoids horizontal scroll conflicts.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom PageRoute for Flutter that enables full-screen back swiping, similar to iOS navigation. It includes smart conflict resolution to work seamlessly with horizontal scrollables like PageView and ListView.
use_when: You want iOS-style full-screen back swipe navigation in your Flutter app.
Your screens contain horizontal scrollables that conflict with standard edge swipe gestures.
avoid_when: You are exclusively using a declarative router like go_router and cannot easily swap out PageRoute types.
You do not need custom page transition animations or gestures.
strengths: Full-screen swipe from anywhere on the screen.
Smart conflict resolution with horizontal scrollables.
Customizable edge width, transition curves, and durations.
weaknesses: Limited to standard Navigator PageRoute usage as documented.
No declarative routing integration details provided.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a complete declarative routing and code-generation navigation solution with deep linking support.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer official declarative routing for managing app navigation and deep links.
